talking-to-arianwyn-before-starting-mour.text: Note: This is not typically possible, because accessing Lletya requires starting the quest Mourning's End Part I.

talking-to-arianwyn-before-starting-mour.npc: How did you get in here? You must leave.

talking-to-arianwyn-before-starting-mour.text: The player is kicked out of Lletya by Arianwyn.

after-mourning-s-end-part-ii.player: Not bad thanks, any news on Lord Iorwerth?

after-mourning-s-end-part-ii.npc: Not yet, I will try to send word if we find out anything new.

after-mourning-s-end-part-ii.player: Oh okay, well see you then.
